method: Convex measured-torque identification of 98 coefficients with positive-semidefinite pseudo-inertia, mass/COM/second-moment and joint-loss bounds; scaled ridge regularization; leave-one-recording-out torque checks; complete Newton candidate evaluations for armature/friction selection.
limitations: Effective dynamics for publisher-filtered observations; measured torque is not recovered raw motor command.
Individual link inertial parameters are not uniquely identified; several fitted COM inertias lie near physical constraint boundaries.
The independent 16-recording fold was not accessed; its verification remains pending.
